product.name: Monoprice DisplayPort 1.4 EasyPlug Nylon Braided Cable 10ft Gray
product.description: The DisplayPort® 1.4 EasyPlug™ Nylon Braided Cable allows you to connect your DisplayPort 1.4 enabled computer to a monitor or other DisplayPort ready device. The non-locking connectors allow you to easily plug and unplug the connectors, so you can enjoy high-resolution video content right away. The cable supports video resolutions up to 8K@60Hz, while the nylon braided jacket resists tangling and protects the cable from nicks and cuts. Easy Plug & PlayNylon Braided JacketDisplayPort 1.4 Compliant8K CapableEasy Plug & Play: The EasyPlug™ connectors provide a snug and secure connection, without the need for the traditional DisplayPort? connector locks.Nylon Braided Jacket: The nylon braided jacket resists tangling and protects the cable from nicks and cuts.DisplayPort 1.4 Compliant: The cable is compliant with the DisplayPort® 1.4 standard, which adds support for Display Stream Compression 1.2 (DSC), Forward Error Correction, and HDR10 extension. Supporting data speeds up to 32.4 Gbps, this cable transmits uncompressed audio and deep color video twice as fast as the previous specification.8K Capable: The high video bandwidth allows this cable to support resolutions up to 8K@60Hz, with HDR or 4K@120Hz with HDR. Available Lengths: 3, 6, 10, and 12 feet FeaturesConnect a DisplayPort® enabled computer to a high definition display or projectorSupports up to 8K resolution and 3D videoUp to 32.4 Gbps bandwidthLatchless EasyPlug™ connectors for quick and easy connectionsSupports DPCP (DisplayPort Content Protection) and HDCP™ (High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection)Backwards compatible with the DisplayPort 1.1, 1.2, and 1.3 standards ApplicationsLifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
